body.objective: Fail closed and diagnose authoritative work/lease events dated later than the caller's explicit coordination snapshot, a common result of local wall time being suffixed with `Z` or a stale scripted timestamp.
body.stop_condition: For every read-only or mutating command supplied `--now T`, compare T as a normalized RFC3339 instant with the maximum relevant event, report and lease timestamps. If an authoritative item or lease event lies later than T, emit a typed `FUTURE_DATED_EVENT` programme-health finding containing event id, actor, raw timestamp, normalized delta, affected item and safe recovery commands; do not silently compute ordinary ACTIVE/READY age or queue forecasts from it. Work-ready/pull/assign/release/close must refuse conflicting mutation on that item or agent until a coordinator explicitly accepts the event timestamp or appends a superseding correction/release; overview may still display the quarantined item but must separate it from healthy live work. Provide a documented UTC timestamp helper or generated shell snippet that cannot produce local wall time mislabeled with `Z`, while preserving explicit caller-supplied time and deterministic replay. Add both-backend fixtures for local-time-plus-literal-Z, a deliberately future deterministic replay, stale scripted now, numeric-offset equivalence, future lease expiry with valid acquisition, and the exact Classical reproduction. Existing historical events remain immutable.
body.current_gate: future-dated coordination event quarantine and actionable UTC diagnostics
body.forbid: no host-clock fallback silently replacing explicit --now; no rewriting event timestamps; no treating every future lease expiry as a future event; no lexical timestamp comparison; no automatic release or scientific failure; no acceptance based on filesystem mtime or Git commit time; no physics-specific agent special case
body.resource_hint: COORDINATION CORRECTNESS. Reuse the landed normalized RFC3339 comparator; the new type is event.when/acquired > caller --now, not expiry > now.
notes: ACCEPTED 2026-07-21 (science-forge). DETECTION SLICE LANDED (master 293f73512): `sfc future-dated <dir> --now T` (also `s-f future-dated`) is a read-only health scan that flags every authoritative event whose recorded `when` is later than T as a typed FUTURE_DATED_EVENT finding (event id, actor, item, raw ts, NORMALIZED delta) with a safe recovery hint; exit 3 if any (fail-closed), 0 clean. Comparison is normalized via rfc3339_epoch (a numeric offset equals its Z form), NEVER lexical; it reads the event `when`, not a lease `expires`, so a legitimately-future expiry is NOT flagged. A future-dated ACQUIRE keeps the lease pending a checkpoint (no accidental-work inference); release only via an explicit holder `s-f work yield` or a coordinator correction. Root-cause prevention: `s-f now` emits a canonical UTC 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ' (date -u) as the --now/--expires source, so scripts can't mislabel local wall time with Z. Reproduction reproduced exactly (2 findings, +5853s). Gate: run.sh FUTURE-DATED (detect + post-clean + offset-normalization + future-expiry-not-flagged + C==native + s-f now format); ASan-clean.

DEFERRED — the mutation QUARANTINE half is a separate phase (mirrored as sf:program/work/SF-future-dated-quarantine): work-ready/pull/assign/release/close must REFUSE conflicting mutation on a future-dated item/agent until a coordinator explicitly accepts the timestamp or appends a superseding correction/release; overview must display the quarantined item SEPARATED from healthy live work (and not compute ordinary ACTIVE/READY age or queue forecasts from it); plus the full both-backend fixture set (local-time-plus-literal-Z, deliberate future deterministic replay, stale scripted now, numeric-offset equivalence, future lease expiry with valid acquisition, and the exact Classical reproduction as an imported quarantine fixture). Forbids honored: no host-clock fallback, no timestamp rewrite, no auto release, no lexical comparison, no mtime/git-time authority, no physics-specific special case.

Exact live reproduction: at coordinator snapshot 2026-07-21T08:07:27Z, overview treated classical-two-phase-counterflow-repaired-q70-generic-isotypical-health as an ordinary live lease acquired by classical-3 at 2026-07-21T09:45:00Z, 5853 seconds in the future. The event files were actually materialized in the shared worktree at approximately 2026-07-21T08:04:42Z, but filesystem time is diagnostic only and must not become authority.

The event used normalized-valid RFC3339 syntax, so the landed offset comparator correctly parsed it; the missing behavior is future-event validation against explicit --now. Preserve the current lease pending a checkpoint because the correct scientific item may genuinely have been claimed; do not infer accidental work solely from the timestamp defect.

Second exact reproduction: at coordinator time 2026-07-21T08:30:34Z, classical-3's newly materialized low-j lease and ACTIVE event claimed acquisition at 2026-07-21T10:30:00Z, almost two hours in the future. It also created a second exclusive lease for the same agent. The coordinator kept the earlier retuning lease and superseded the low-j item by higher sequence; retain the future-dated events as an imported quarantine fixture.

Remaining overview reproduction at snapshot 2026-07-21T10:15:32Z: the Bridge third-order Kuranishi completion recorded at 2026-07-21T18:04:00+02:00 is correctly detected by `s-f future-dated`, but still appears as the first ordinary entry in overview RECENT RESULTS. The quarantine phase must exclude or separately label such entries so recency and completion feeds cannot be inferred from them before their authoritative time is accepted or superseded.
